# RPC reference

JSON-RPC 2.0, one object per line over TCP on `127.0.0.1`. Every request carries a `"token"` member. Example:

```
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"scene.get","params":{},"token":"..."}
```

Command-shaped work goes through `command.run`; the command ids and arguments are in the [command reference](commands.md).

## Methods

| Method | Params | Result | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `app.version` | - | `{"name","version","protocol"}` | Server name, version and protocol revision. |
| `command.list` | - | `{"commands": [{"id","label","undoable","args_schema"}]}` | The command registry with JSON Schemas (the same data as the command reference). |
| `command.run` | `{"id": str, "args": object}` | `{"command": id, "result": value}` | Runs one command in the editor's own context; one undo step if it edits. |
| `scene.get` | - | `{"fps","start","end","frame","nodes","selected","roots"}` | Project settings, selection and the node tree with parameters in user units. |
| `node.get` | `{"id": int}` | `node object` | One node (type, parameters, tags, animated tracks, children). |
| `eval.mesh` | `{"node": int, "frame"?: int}` | `{"node","frame","points","polys"}` | The node's evaluated mesh in world space; the timeline does not move. |
| `timeline.get` | - | `{"frame","fps","start","end","playing","autokey","preview","mode","drop_frames","display","text","markers"}` | Timeline state. |
| `viewport.screenshot` | `{"width"?: int, "height"?: int}` | `{"width","height","format":"png","data": base64}` | Renders the editor viewport offscreen (1 to 4096 per side, default 800x600). Needs a viewport and a GPU. |
| `events.subscribe` | `{"kinds"?: [str]}` | `{"kinds": [str]}` | Subscribes this connection to notification kinds (`scene`, `frame`, `selection`, `commands`; absent means all). |
| `events.unsubscribe` | `{"kinds"?: [str]}` | `{"kinds": [str]}` | Removes kinds from the subscription (absent means all). |
| `job.start` | `{"kind": str, "args"?: object}` | `{"job_id": int}` | Starts a long job (kind `export.obj_sequence`: `dir`, `start`, `end`, `step`, `prefix`). Progress arrives as notifications. |
| `job.cancel` | `{"id": int}` | `{"id","cancelled"}` | Stops a running job before its next slice. |
| `job.list` | - | `{"jobs": [{"id","kind","state","fraction","message"}]}` | Running jobs and the last 32 ended ones. |

## Notifications

Request-shaped lines without `id`, never answered.

| Notification | Params | Sent when |
|---|---|---|
| `scene.changed` | `{"revision": int}` | The scene revision changed (edit, undo, load). Kind `scene`. |
| `frame.changed` | `{"frame": int}` | The current frame changed. Kind `frame`. |
| `selection.changed` | `{"nodes": [int]}` | The object selection changed. Kind `selection`. |
| `commands.changed` | `{"count": int}` | The command list changed. Kind `commands`. |
| `job.progress` | `{"id","fraction","message"}` | After each slice of a job, to the connection that started it (no subscription needed). |
| `job.finished` | `{"id","state","result"?,"error"?}` | A job ended (`done`, `cancelled`, `failed`), to the connection that started it. |

## Error codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| -32700 | parse error (the line is not JSON) |
| -32600 | invalid request (not an object, no `id`, `method` not a string, wrong `jsonrpc`) |
| -32601 | unknown method |
| -32602 | invalid params (missing or wrongly typed field) |
| -32603 | internal error (handler panic, editor gone) |
| -32000 | the call ran and failed (a command refused, unknown node, no viewport); `data.kind` says what |
| -32001 | unauthorized (token missing or wrong); the connection is closed |
| -32002 | rate limited (the request did not run) |
| -32003 | message too large; the connection is closed |
| -32004 | too many connections; the connection is closed |
| -32005 | the editor did not answer in time |

## Limits

| Limit | Value |
|---|---|
| default port | 7323 |
| request line | 8388608 bytes |
| requests per second per connection | 50 |
| simultaneous connections | 4 |
| queued notifications per connection | 1024 |
| running jobs | 8 |
| screenshot side | 1 to 4096 pixels |
